Hello everyone!
I haven’t been around for a while, and unfortunately, that’s starting to feel like a tradition. However, I’m back with some good news i fixed it. This time, I tracked down and fixed crashes that could occur after completing the tutorial and creating a faction. I also discovered that the game might crash when running with certain VPNs and antivirus software — so if you're experiencing crashes, try disabling your VPN or antivirus.

That’s about it for now. I don’t want to make any promises, but I might soon add nude body models — survivors will initially spawn without clothes. The models are almost done. Also, future updates related to core mechanics will first be tested in the test branch before being merged into the main one.

Oh, and yes — I’ve updated the main branch too, since this one now seems more stable. I’m too lazy to list all the changes in detail, so check them out yourselves. But in short, there’s: a new resource — radioactive crystals, new buildings related to them like a nuclear reactor, a reworked UI, balance changes, and of course, the "early stages of crafting" — breaking items down into scrap and opening loot boxes.

[b]If you happen to encounter a bug or crash, it would be helpful to add this launch parameter: [u]-logfile log.txt[/u] If the crash happens again, you’ll find the `log.txt` file in the game folder — send it to me so I can fix the issue more quickly.[/b]
[i]Note: enabling logging may impact game performance slightly, so this step is optional.[/i]

Hello everyone
I haven't been here for a long time and during my absence you have accumulated a lot of questions and error messages, sorry for leaving them unanswered, but I have good news, I fixed the main errors and released an update on the test branch.
This update does not bring significant changes to the gameplay, but fixes all visual artifacts, crashes and breakdowns of the game.
Perhaps the old saves will stop working correctly, so they will have to be deleted, but when creating a new game, errors should no longer appear.
Another good news is that I'm slowly getting back to work on this project, so cool new updates are waiting for you soon!
I won't promise much, because my free time is still very limited, but I will try to release updates at least once every 1-2 months. Thanks to everyone who waited and supported, I really appreciate it!

Hello!
For those who did not know, I work as a chef and due to work I have very little free time for my projects, so the release of updates is constantly delayed, however, I read all your feedback and error messages, trying to pay attention to fixing them.

Today I decided to upload a test update for those who have been playing for a long time and managed to accumulate a huge number of the same items, in this update you can exchange them for profile experience in the warehouse window. In the future, items will be traded for junk that you can use to craft new items, so if you don't need profile experience, you can wait and make a better trade. Also in this update, you can open all the boxes that you have accumulated, all in the same warehouse window, go to which you can through the main menu by clicking on the "Storage" button.

In general, this update will have a lot of new things, a new interface, a new resource, new buildings, I won’t describe everything yet, because, as I wrote above, this update is a test one and after some time I will upload a new full-fledged update with a full description of all fixes and innovations.

Please note that the test update is released only for Windows operating systems and will most likely break old saves, so for it to work correctly, you will need to clean your game worlds.

You can download a test update in the following way: right-click on the game in the steam client, in the drop-down window click on the "properties" tab, then click on the "beta versions" tab and select "test_update - Test update branch", after that close the window and wait for the update to download.

If you find bugs, or you have any suggestions, write in the discussions of the game's community center, I will be glad to all your messages!

notes.title: New Year.
notes.notes:
Hi.

To say that this year has been difficult is an understatement.
And to be honest, I don’t want to say anything, but I need to.

In all my 26 years of life, I have not seen as much shit as happened in this miserable year.
This year: I witnessed the world go crazy, attended my grandmother's funeral, attended the funeral of a friend, got into a financial hole, sold projects, returned to work as a cook and released 4 updates for FD.

All in all, it was a busy year.

I wanted to finish the update by the new year and launch the annual New Year's event, but unfortunately I have absolutely no strength, either morally or physically, the work takes me 13 hours a day, so there is very little time left for the project, and even less strength .

In short, there will be no new year.

However, I would like to wish that the new year still was, and it was beautiful, because the black stripes must someday end, in the name of the beginning of the white ones!

I hope that in the new year I will have more free time and I can devote it to this project so that updates come out more often and with better quality, making you happy!

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Hey!
notes.notes:
Hey!
Spring and gardening seem to cure any depression and I seem to be starting to feel better!
I still have small problems that prevent me from implementing a full-fledged crafting system in the game (which, by the way, has been ready for a long time, but the steam server does not want to give correct answers to requests through the inventory) and some other things, but in order not to stagnate, I I decided to leave it for the future and do other plans for this project, so I will try to release an update in the near future!
I also spent a lot of time in a cool game called Rust from a wonderful person Garry Newman and his Facepunch team. Once I was very inspired by this game, and start made a project in the first-person survival genre (the announcement was in the VKontakte group many years ago, but the project was soon frozen) and now, having played it again, I have some new ideas for the First Day game, which I would like to discuss with you.
What do you think about adding a new type of turret to the game? For example, would you like to see a rocket launcher in the game? Do you want to see more explosions and have powerful defense against bulky enemies?
And what do you think about adding a farming system to the game? For example, would you like to be able to tame wild animals, breed them and use them as a food source? Would you like to see a new greenhouse built that would be able to grow food?
Share your opinion on this matter and offer your ideas, I will definitely consider the implementation of all your good ideas in this project!

[i]The last month has been a tough one for me, both mentally and physically, to say the least, but I've tried to work on the update as much as possible.
Those of you who have been following the project from the very beginning already know that I work on it alone, I do not have any funding and I develop it on my own, the only reason this project continues to live is my desire to give the world something something good and make people even a little happier. Sometimes there come moments when my mind is clouded by problems and sorrows, then I forget about my desire and aspiration, devaluing my own work, doubts come about my goals and the correctness of the chosen path. At such moments, I re-read your comments and reviews about this project, they help me remember that after all, I chose the right path. Your kind words keep the fire burning inside of me and encourage me to develop this project further, but with the depletion of resources, it becomes more and more difficult. Many of you know that item drops in the game are balanced so that the player does not need to buy them, and the purchase of items in the game itself would be just a way to support the project. By transferring the project to a free version, I wanted to give everyone the opportunity to access the game so that everyone could evaluate the project and become part of it. Unfortunately this was a mistake. After switching to the free version, I received some completely unconstructive negative feedback, and that significant increase in players did not have any positive effect in the community, as a result, this project became even more unprofitable.
I am sorry to inform you that I will again have to take up work on a side project and freeze the development of this project indefinitely, in order to form a budget for subsequent work on First Day.
I will still monitor possible bugs after this update and release a patch to fix them, but the release of subsequent updates is in doubt.
Due to all of the above, I decided to release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893250/First_Day__Supporter_Pack/?beta=0]DLC to support[/url] the project and speed up the release of new updates, this DLC will contain in itself exclusive sets of things that will change every few months.
